item.title: hyperframes v0.9.83
item.description: Compiling a page with thousands of clips or style rules stays fast. The notes also list a fix that shipped in v0.9.82: a sandboxed app reads project history again.

item.title: hyperframes v0.9.82
item.description: A preview loads GSAP's motion path plugin from the page's own GSAP folder or the host's copy, so it works with no network. Sealed previews get more fixes, from sound and the keyboard to moves inside nested compositions.

item.title: hyperframes v0.9.81
item.description: A heavy page now renders without running out of memory: a render starts only as many browsers as fit. Sealed previews take more edits in place, from moves and crops to undo and hotkeys.

item.title: hyperframes v0.9.80
item.description: Dropping a clip onto main-track clips can now insert it there. Studio previews match the export more closely, and a drive that stops answering no longer stalls a project.

item.title: hyperframes v0.9.79
item.description: Trimming a main-track clip with Ripple on now closes the gap. Media files that sit outside a project are no longer reused, credited or written through a linked folder.

item.title: hyperframes v0.9.78
item.description: Undo after an agent step now brings back the files it changed. A catalog gap report on Windows never puts a query your shell would run into a command, and renders sharing one capture proxy keep their connections.

item.title: hyperframes v0.9.77
item.description: CLI messages now show control characters as plain text. An undo in Studio never deletes a file another page still uses, and big root previews no longer hold up other requests.

item.title: hyperframes v0.9.75
item.description: Seeking a film with many videos no longer hangs Safari. Opening and pruning history no longer stalls on a slow project folder, and CLI writes never follow a link already in a project.

item.title: hyperframes v0.9.74
item.description: Films whose later scene sets an !important background on an id no longer render blank. Clips dropped on a sealed preview show on the timeline, and a package that fails to publish is tried again.
